name: ibis Pontianak City Center
short_description: A 182-room budget hotel in central Pontianak on Jalan Ahmad Yani, built in 2016 and close to the city's largest shopping mall.
ai_summary: ibis Pontianak City Center is a 182-room, 12-floor hotel on Jalan Jendral Ahmad Yani, built in 2016 in the heart of Pontianak near the city's largest shopping mall and government offices, about 16km from Supadio International Airport. Rooms run from 18-square-meter standard doubles/twins to 24-square-meter superior kings, and the property includes Ibis Kitchen restaurant and bar, a spa, and 10 meeting rooms, the largest at 443 square meters and able to host weddings for up to 540 guests. Guest reviews are consistently positive on location, cleanliness, breakfast variety, and friendly, efficient service, with only occasional mentions of minor maintenance issues or odors.

core_facts.address: Jl Jendral Ahmad Yani No 81, Pontianak, 78124 West Kalimantan, Indonesia
core_facts.neighborhood: Central Pontianak, near Ayani Mega Mall and government offices
core_facts.elite_notes: As a budget-tier ibis property, this hotel offers standard ALL - Accor Live Limitless member rates and points-earning, without the premium benefits (lounge access, guaranteed upgrades) reserved for upscale-brand properties.

pros: Central Pontianak location near the city's biggest shopping mall and government offices
182 rooms across 12 floors, built in 2016, with a 443-square-meter function room hosting weddings for up to 540 guests
Consistently praised for cleanliness, comfort, and value
Good breakfast variety noted repeatedly across guest reviews
cons: As a budget-tier ibis property, it lacks upscale amenities like a pool or premium lounge
Occasional guest mentions of minor maintenance issues or odors
16km from Supadio International Airport, requiring a taxi or shuttle for arrivals
research_highlights: Long-established property (built 2016) with a large, consistent review base rating it around 4.6/5
Central location and breakfast quality are the most repeated praise points
Function space capacity (up to 540 guests) makes it a popular local wedding and event venue
research_watchouts: A minority of reviews mention minor maintenance issues or odors that a newer competing property might not have

faqs.question: Is ibis Pontianak City Center part of the ALL loyalty program?
faqs.answer: Yes -- as a budget-tier ibis property, guests earn and redeem points at standard ALL - Accor Live Limitless member rates, though it does not offer the premium perks like lounge access or guaranteed upgrades that upscale-brand Accor hotels provide to higher-tier members.

faqs.question: How far is ibis Pontianak City Center from the airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about 16.4 kilometers from Supadio International Airport, roughly a 20-30 minute drive depending on traffic, and sits centrally within Pontianak near the city's largest shopping mall, government offices, and residential districts, making it a convenient base for both business and leisure visits.
